test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following sets of lengths (in cm) will give three sides of an obtuse-angled triangle?
solution:
**Concept used:**

If the square of any one side of a triangle > the sum of the square of the other two sides, then the triangle will be called obtuse-angled triangle.

**Calculation:**

From the given options,

In Option 1,

64² = 4096 and (15² + 62²) = 4069

Here, 64² > (152 + 622)

∴ The correct answer is option 1
